entries.52458ac7503ab240: A company that, through its consolidated subsidiary, runs the franchise headquarters business for the "Lawson Three F" convenience stores, and also operates directly managed stores of its new format "gooz."
entries.a24bf4990ab10451: This is a new convenience store format for which the company operates company-owned stores. These stores cook bakery items and bento boxes in-store to promote a freshly made feel; the number of stores was 3 in the fiscal year ended February 2026.
entries.da5a5b983f5deac7: This is a business in which consolidated subsidiary L.T.F. Co., Ltd., as chain headquarters, provides management guidance to franchised stores and operates company-owned stores in Tokyo, Kanagawa, Chiba and Saitama (the one metropolis and three prefectures). The number of stores was 325 in the fiscal year ended February 2026.
entries.dd98174379731d3b: This is the single segment of the company group. As the chain headquarters of the convenience store 'Lawson Three F', consolidated subsidiary L.T.F. Co., Ltd. provides management guidance to franchised stores and operates company-owned stores, while the company manages and operates L.T.F.'s business activities, supports the development of products sold at 'Lawson Three F', and operates company-owned stores of the new format 'gooz'. Total operating revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 is ¥15,084 million.
